purpose.domain_detail: School/education management system ('openjensen') listing users (pupils, teachers, administrators) from a database via a CGI web interface
purpose.summary: This CGI program retrieves and lists users from a database table (tbl_user) filtered by user type (pupil, teacher, administrator, etc.). It connects to a PostgreSQL/MySQL-like database, fetches lookup data for user types and programs, then outputs an HTML table of users. It is part of a Swedish school management web application.

notable_features: EXEC SQL with cursors (DECLARE, OPEN, FETCH, CLOSE)
CGI web output via DISPLAY of HTML tags
CALL to external CGI helper routines (wui-print-header, get-post-value, write-post-string, stop-printscr)
Indexed table lookups for user types and program names
